description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notifying that the Final Budget Position Report - Annual Report of Ministry of Finance - 2015 is available for inspection
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the publication of the "Final Budget Position Report" issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The content specifically deals with a statutory instrument (the Act) and the regulatory compliance requirement of publishing an annual financial report. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it concerns regulatory frameworks and statutory reporting requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
